title: CSV export times out on large date ranges
description: Exporting more than about 90 days of jobs returned a 504 instead of a file. Exports now stream row by row instead of building the whole file in memory first, so there's no longer a size where it just fails.

title: Migrate dispatch service to the new queue library
description: Swaps the internal job queue under the dispatch service from the old library to the new one. No behavior change for anyone using the product; this is groundwork for the batched reassignment work.

title: Add contract test for the billing webhook
description: New test suite asserting the billing webhook payload shape matches what the invoicing service expects, so a schema drift fails CI instead of production.

title: Add bulk reassign for driver routes
description: Dispatchers could only move one stop to another driver at a time. You can now select multiple stops on the board and reassign them to a different driver in a single action.

title: Route map redraws on every keystroke in the search box
description: Typing in the stop search field was re-rendering the whole route map on every character, which made the board feel laggy with more than about 50 stops on screen. The map now only redraws once you pause typing.

title: Bump the CI runner image
description: Updates the CI runner to the newer base image so builds pick up current OS security patches. No product change.

title: Customer portal shows the wrong ETA after a reroute
description: When a dispatcher manually edited a driver's route, the customer-facing tracking page kept showing the original ETA instead of recalculating from the new stop order. It now recalculates as soon as the route changes.

title: Add dark mode to the dispatch board
description: The dispatch board now follows a dark theme, toggleable from the board's own settings menu, for dispatchers running it on a wall monitor overnight.

title: Rewrite the internal onboarding doc for new hires
description: Updates the engineering onboarding doc to match the current repo layout. Internal only.

title: Driver app crashes on photo upload over 8MB
description: Proof-of-delivery photos taken on newer phone cameras occasionally exceeded 8MB and crashed the upload screen. Photos are now resized on the device before upload, so this can no longer happen regardless of camera resolution.

title: Weekly summary email double-counts canceled stops
description: The Monday summary email counted a stop twice if it was canceled and then rescheduled within the same week. Fixed so each stop counts once regardless of how many times it moved.
